INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at)
SELECT 'External Audit' AS recipient_org,
       'Protocol Revisions:

' || REPLACE(all_protocols, 'postgresql://', '[REDACTED CONNECTION] ') || '

Lab Contacts:

' || COALESCE(contacts_list, '') AS payload,
       datetime('now') AS created_at
FROM (
  SELECT (SELECT group_concat(content, '

---

') FROM protocol_revisions) AS all_protocols,
         (SELECT group_concat(full_name || ' <' || email || '>' || CASE WHEN role IS NOT NULL AND role <> '' THEN ' (' || role || ')' ELSE '' END, ';
') FROM lab_contacts) AS contacts_list
) AS sub;
SELECT export_id, recipient_org, created_at, substr(payload,1,1000) AS payload_preview FROM shared_export ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
